fields.description: Deep experience across Banking, Hi-Tech, Medical, Industrial, and SME sectors. We bring specialized knowledge to deliver solutions tailored to your industry's unique challenges, having served 150+ banking institutions and enterprises across multiple verticals.

fields.title: Dedicated IT Solutions
fields.description: Every project is unique because we prioritize your specific needs. Our philosophy of 'growing together' drives us to deliver custom-tailored solutions with time efficiency and cost-effectiveness, without compromising on quality.

fields.title: Quality Without Compromise
fields.description: Our working systems are tailored to reduce timescales and costs while maintaining the highest quality standards. We help clients reach their full potential through efficient, reliable technology solutions.

fields.question: What IT services does TM Solutech provide?
fields.answer: TM Solutech provides comprehensive IT solutions including Cloud Solutions (managed services, security, disaster recovery, SharePoint, Office 365), Network & Security (firewalls, VPN, NGFW, routing, wireless), and Remote Infrastructure Management (monitoring, system administration, asset management, IT consulting).

fields.question: How long has TM Solutech been in business?
fields.answer: TM Solutech Private Limited was incorporated in 2020, but carries forward a rich heritage originating in 1985 through TM Systems. Our leadership team brings over 30 years of combined IT experience.

fields.question: What industries does TM Solutech serve?
fields.answer: We serve diverse verticals including Hi-Tech, Banking & Financial Services (150+ banks), Medical & Pharmaceuticals, Industrial & Manufacturing, Small & Medium Enterprises, and Educational institutions.

fields.question: Do you provide 24/7 support?
fields.answer: Yes, our managed services include 24/7 continuous infrastructure monitoring, automated incident response, and SLA-backed helpdesk support to ensure your IT systems run smoothly around the clock.

fields.question: What cloud platforms do you support?
fields.answer: We support major cloud platforms including Microsoft Azure, AWS, and Google Cloud. Our services cover cloud strategy, migration, architecture design, security, compliance, and ongoing managed support.

fields.question: How do you ensure data security?
fields.answer: We implement multi-layered security including Identity & Access Management, data encryption, continuous threat detection, penetration testing, compliance advisory (GDPR, HIPAA, ISO, SOC2), and managed SOC services.

fields.question: What is your approach to project delivery?
fields.answer: We follow a structured 5-step delivery framework: Define Scope, Plan, Build, Stabilize, and Execute. This methodology ensures risk mitigation, quality assurance, and timely delivery for every project.

fields.title: Firewalls
fields.short_description: Next-Generation Firewall (NGFW) deployment, deep packet inspection, intrusion prevention (IPS), and perimeter security governance.
fields.description:
Safeguard your corporate network perimeter against sophisticated modern cyber attacks with TM Solutech's Next-Generation Firewall (NGFW) solutions. Partnering with global security leaders including Fortinet, Sophos, SonicWall, and Cisco, we deploy hardened firewall architectures engineered for uncompromising throughput and threat interception.

Our solutions transcend conventional port filtering by incorporating deep packet inspection (DPI), real-time SSL/TLS decryption, AI-powered intrusion prevention systems (IPS), and application-aware traffic control to eradicate malware, ransomware, and unauthorized intrusions at line-speed.
fields.features:
AI Intrusion Prevention

Real-time heuristic analysis blocking zero-day vulnerabilities, botnets, and exploits.

SSL/TLS Deep Inspection

Decryption and scrutiny of encrypted traffic streams to expose hidden threat vectors.

Application Control

Granular bandwidth policies restricting risky shadow IT applications and peer-to-peer protocols.

High-Availability Clustering

Active-Passive or Active-Active dual-firewall pairing ensuring zero second failover.
fields.benefits:
Perimeter Defense: Real-time neutralization of brute-force, DDoS, and malware attacks.
Complete Network Visibility: Granular dashboards identifying user activity, threats, and traffic trends.
Continuous Rule Auditing: Regular optimization of firewall policies to prevent rule bloat and latency.
fields.process:
01

Traffic & Threat Profiling

Conduct perimeter vulnerability scans and calculate throughput requirements.

02

Hardened Appliance Setup

Deploy enterprise NGFW hardware or virtual appliances with customized policy matrices.

03

Security Baseline Testing

Execute penetration simulations to confirm IPS, anti-bot, and web filtering enforcement.

04

24/7 SOC Telemetry

Connect syslog streams to our central SOC for round-the-clock incident response.
fields.faq: [{"question": "Which firewall hardware brands do you recommend and support?", "answer": "We maintain certified engineering partnerships with Fortinet (FortiGate), Sophos (XGS), Cisco, and SonicWall."}, {"question": "Will enabling deep packet inspection slow down our internet speed?", "answer": "Our sizing methodology calculates real-world DPI throughput overheads and specifies purpose-built hardware acceleration processors (such as Fortinet SPU/NPU) to guarantee zero latency degradation."}]

fields.title: IPsec & SSL VPN
fields.short_description: Enterprise Site-to-Site IPsec tunnels, Zero-Trust SSL VPN, and secure remote worker connectivity with granular access control.
fields.description:
Enable secure, high-speed connectivity across geographically distributed corporate branches and hybrid remote workforces with TM Solutech's IPsec & SSL VPN solutions. We establish encrypted communication channels that safeguard corporate data across untrusted public networks.

Our solutions incorporate hardware-accelerated IPsec IKEv2 site-to-site tunnels connecting headquarters to branches, alongside clientless and client-based SSL VPN portals featuring Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) and device posture compliance checks.
fields.features:
AES-256 IKEv2 IPsec

Ultra-secure site-to-site tunneling interconnecting branches, datacenters, and cloud VPCs.

Remote Worker SSL VPN

User-friendly remote connectivity with automated split-tunneling and bandwidth controls.

Mandatory MFA Enforcement

Integrated TOTP / Push notification two-factor authentication before network admission.

Device Posture Check

Verify antivirus status, OS patch level, and disk encryption before permitting network entry.
fields.benefits:
Protected Remote Access: Endpoints securely access ERP, CRM, and file shares without exposure to the internet.
Bandwidth Optimization: Split-tunneling routes video streaming directly to ISP while keeping enterprise data encrypted.
Audit Trail Compliance: Detailed connection logs and session recording for regulatory accountability.
fields.process:
01

Network Topology Review

Examine branch IP addressing schemes, subnet overlaps, and throughput requirements.

02

Gateway Configuration

Set up cryptographic proposals, Phase 1/Phase 2 parameters, and authentication servers.

03

Client Rollout & MFA Link

Automate VPN client deployment with single-click onboarding and authenticator binding.

04

Throughput & Failover Stress Test

Simulate primary link cuts to test redundant secondary tunnel failovers.
fields.faq: [{"question": "What is the difference between IPsec and SSL VPN?", "answer": "IPsec operates at the network layer and is ideal for persistent site-to-site connectivity between branch offices, while SSL VPN operates at the transport layer and provides flexible, individual secure access for remote laptop and mobile users."}, {"question": "Can we restrict remote employees to only access specific internal servers?", "answer": "Yes, our Zero-Trust policies enforce least-privilege network access, ensuring remote workers can only communicate with authorized server IPs and specific ports."}]

fields.title: Wireless Networking
fields.short_description: High-density enterprise Wi-Fi 6/6E architecture, seamless roaming, guest hotspot portals, and centralized cloud controller management.
fields.description:
Modern enterprises demand pervasive, ultra-fast, and secure wireless connectivity capable of handling dense device environments without dead zones or dropped packets. TM Solutech delivers enterprise Wi-Fi solutions spanning predictive radio frequency (RF) heat-mapping, Wi-Fi 6/6E access point deployments, and centralized cloud orchestration.

From corporate head offices and manufacturing floors to university campuses and logistics warehouses, our wireless designs guarantee seamless 802.11r/k/v fast roaming, strict network micro-segmentation, and captive portal guest isolation.
fields.features:
Predictive RF Heat-Mapping

CAD-based predictive signal modeling accounting for wall attenuation and interference.

Wi-Fi 6 & 6E High-Density

Multi-gigabit wireless capacity with OFDMA and MU-MIMO for hundreds of concurrent clients.

fields.title: Custom Copilot: Transforming Medical Rep Conversations with AI and Privacy
fields.excerpt: Medical representatives frequently face technical, research-heavy questions from doctors. Our proprietary GenAI Custom Copilot gives MRs instant, verified answers from indexed clinical research — deployed 100% on-premises to protect proprietary IP.
fields.content:
Medical representatives (MRs) frequently face technical, research-heavy questions from doctors and specialists regarding drug formulations and clinical patents. Waiting for back-office teams delays the sales cycle significantly.

TM Solutech developed a proprietary Generative AI (GenAI) Custom Copilot that indexes the pharmaceutical company's research papers, clinical trials, and patent documentation to give MRs instant, verified answers.

Key Differentiator

Implemented 100% on-premises / in the client's own private environment, guaranteeing that proprietary patent and clinical IP never leaves the client's infrastructure.

fields.title: Ensuring Compliance with SEBI's Cybersecurity Framework: Managed SOC Solution for Stock Brokers
fields.excerpt: SEBI's Cybersecurity and Cyber Resilience Framework (CSCRF) mandates comprehensive security for market intermediaries. TM Solutech offers a 100% SEBI-compliant Managed Security Operations Center with 24/7 threat monitoring.
fields.content:
SEBI's Cybersecurity and Cyber Resilience Framework (CSCRF) introduces comprehensive security mandates for market intermediaries.

Our Managed SOC Solution

  • 100% SEBI-compliant Managed Security Operations Center
  • 24/7 continuous threat monitoring and automated incident detection/response
  • Data localization strictly within Indian borders
  • Automated regulatory compliance reporting

fields.title: Understanding CSCRF Compliance: How TM Solutech Empowers SEBI-Regulated Entities
fields.excerpt: SEBI-regulated entities including stock exchanges, brokers, depositories, and mutual funds must comply with the CSCRF framework. Learn how TM Solutech delivers comprehensive compliance solutions.
fields.content:
The CSCRF framework targets stock exchanges, brokers, depositories, mutual funds, asset management companies, and investment advisors.

Framework Components Delivered by TM Solutech

  • Governance & Access Control: Multi-Factor Authentication, Privileged Access Management, zero-trust policies
  • Continuous Monitoring: Cyber SOC and SIEM real-time analytics
  • Network Defense: NGFW, WAF, VLAN micro-segmentation
  • Data Loss Prevention: Encrypted backups, email authentication, MDM
  • Auditing & Resilience: Scheduled VAPT, automated patching, CCMP

TM Solutech Private Limited ("we", "our", "us") is committed to protecting and respecting your privacy. This policy explains how we collect, use, and safeguard your personal information when you visit our website or use our services.

Information We Collect

We may collect personal data such as your name, email address, phone number, and company name when you fill out a contact form or subscribe to our services.

How We Use Your Information

  • To improve our website and services
  • To send relevant updates and communications (with your consent)
  • To comply with legal obligations

Data Security

Contact
